text:
Tara Lin: quick sync / we need a compact spec for a Migration Escrow lane and a compatibility-bridge pattern so Sales can promise exact timelines without ops firefighting.
Victor Ho: define Migration Escrow: customer opts in, we reserve dedicated canary capacity + a small escrow fee; guarantees migration within lane window and an SLA-backed rollback.
Marta Ruiz: sounds good. propose lanes: ESCROW (0-21d concierge, paid escrow), BRIDGE (22-60d auto-shim + self-serve), FROZEN (contract-only read-only pins).
Kenji W: acceptance gates (machine-checkable): tokenizer_checksum match OR shim-able mapping, kv_schema_compatible OR migrator success, perf_p95 threshold, eval_delta threshold, safety_regression cap. Also require audit_hashes for pre/post eval.
Olive Sales: customers will ask "what does escrow buy us?" we need a clear answer: priority canary, named AM, credits for downtime, and guaranteed rollback SLA (30m for critical). Also a template message.
Tara Lin: numeric drafts: ESCROW perf_p95 <= 120ms (<=128 tokens) on Dedicated, eval_f1_drop <= 1.5%, cost_delta <= +8%; BRIDGE: p95 <= 160ms, f1_drop <= 3.0%, soft-pin TTL 90d.
Victor Ho: safety gate: critical_prompt_set (50) with auto-block if high-sev triggers increase >15% or any 0->1 high-sev. hallucination_ratio >1.25x -> fail.
Marta Ruiz: ops snippet for Console (to wire):
```
migration_lanes:
  - id: escrow
    type: concierge
    canary_pct: 10
    duration_hours: 24
    monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta, safety_ratio]
    escrow_fee_flag: escrow_enabled
    rollback_sla_minutes: 30
  - id: bridge
    type: selfserve
    initial_pct: 5
    ramp_to: 25
    duration_hours: 72
    shim_layer: true
    soft_pin_ttl_days: 90
```
ops-bot: queued: run "escrow-preflight-v1" on ded-escrow-1, eta 5467890160
Kenji W: telemetry required: emit migration_id, tenant_id, lane_id, pre_eval_hash, post_eval_hash, shim_used, escrow_flag, rollback_invoked. store snapshots 180d.
Olive Sales: contract note: permanent pin only with "pin_lock" clause and signed appendix; escrow is billed separately but reduces migration notice windows. Legal to draft language.
Marta Ruiz: rollout guardrails: auto-rollback if latency > baseline*1.2 for 10m OR eval_delta > allowed OR shim failure rate > 5%. fallback variant defined as family-compat-quant.
bench-bot: run complete: median 92ms, p95 118ms, eval_delta 1.2%, safety_ratio 0.98 -> PASS for ESCROW gates
Tara Lin: great. owners: Marta -> console wiring + shim spec, Kenji -> telemetry + audit hashes, Victor -> escrow billing flag + SLA text, Olive -> sales templates + customer FAQ, Tara -> migration-runbook PR. target PRs by 5467890155.
Victor Ho: i'll draft escrow FAQ blurb: what we guarantee, how credits work, rollback flow, and how refunds are handled if SLA missed.
Tara Lin: plan to merge runbook when PRs land. schedule first Escrow canary 09:00 PT tomorrow if all sign off. keep updates in-thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
